title: Respiratory and Cardiovascular Effects in COPD
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to find out if subjects with chronic obstructive pulmonary disease have signs of accelerated ageing in their airways.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Clinical diagnosis of COPD, GOLD stage 2-3.
* Smoking history of at least 10 packyears.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Severe ischemic heart disease.
* Other severe disease.
* Respiratory infection within four weeks.
